messages:
Talia (PM): Quick sync — field asks two delivery patterns for private deploys: slim operator (fast onboarding) vs operator+relay (egress preservation, BGP handoff). Which do we GA first?
Raj (Eng-Infra): Slim reduces ops surface and is easier to support. Relay needed for big customers. Could GA slim and ship relay as opt-in later.
Marta (Field): Enterprise customers insist on preserved egress. They'll only sign with relay or equivalent. Need a documented dry-run for NetOps.
Eli (Security): Relay increases attack surface. Must require mTLS, HSM/KMS-backed key material, audit logs, and cert rotation checks before GA.
Sam (CS): Sales wants clear SLAs. Suggest GA = slim operator + migration tooling. Relay = beta with canary customers.
Talia (PM): Draft launch checklist: preflight (kube version, nodes), network dry-run (simulate BGP/NAT), KMS smoke, cert rotation test, staged rollback validated, docs + SLA blurb.
Raj (Eng-Infra): I'll prototype a migration CLI and a feature flag: `priv.operator.upgrade_mode = inplace|relay`. Migration command: `rctl migrate --tenant <id> --mode relay --dry-run`.
Marta (Field): Dry-run must output a netops-ready report (BGP peers, expected egress IP mapping). Customers want a copyable checklist.
Eli (Security): Add automated cert provenance check and require telemetry opt-in for debug during migration.
Sam (CS): SLA proposals: operator in-place median 20m, 95p 60m. Relay-assisted median 60m, 95p 3h — validate with canaries.
Talia (PM): Action items: Raj owner for CLI, Eli owner for security gating, Marta to recruit 2 canary customers, Sam to draft SLA blurb. I'll post acceptance criteria doc here when ready. :white_check_mark:
